title: QuickBill Pro
prompt:
Build a complete, Play-Store-grade commercial Shop Billing, Udhar Khata, Customer Notes & Daily Sales app named QuickBill Pro. Keep the public app 100% clean with zero admin panels or secret passwords.
1. CUSTOM LOGO & SPLASH: Show a sleek dark-navy & emerald splash screen with a bold billing/receipt emblem and "Version 1.0" for 1 second.
2. REAL MOBILE NUMBER LOGIN & PROFILE: Login screen with Shop/User Full Name and 10-digit Mobile Number saved directly to Supabase cloud via FactoryDB.login(). After login, show a slide-out Profile Drawer and a dedicated Profile Tab displaying the saved Name, Mobile Number, Shop Type, Total Bills, Total Sales, and Logout button.
3. 4-TAB BOTTOM NAVIGATION (with Lucide SVG icons, zero emojis):
   - Tab 1 (Home): Live counters (Today's Sales Rs., Pending Udhar Rs., Total Bills), Quick Action buttons (New Bill, Add Udhar, Collect Cash, Daily Report), and a live Sales Chart (Chart.js).
   - Tab 2 (Billing): Add item name, quantity, and price with instant GST/discount calculation (zero NaN errors), generate a clean receipt popup via FactoryUI.receipt(), save to Supabase via FactoryDB.recordTx(), and include a "Send Bill on WhatsApp" button (using https://wa.me/?text=... with full bill text).
   - Tab 3 (Khata & Notes): Customer list with Udhar/Jama balance tracker, plus a Customer Note Pad / Reminder box to save order notes or follow-up messages per customer in Supabase/localStorage.
   - Tab 4 (Profile & History): Full Transaction History loaded from FactoryDB.getTransactions(), Shop Profile details, and Logout.
4. UI/UX: High-contrast dark theme (#0b0f19 background, vivid emerald/blue buttons, zero white-on-white buttons or inputs).
